opening.argument: The title identifies this as an RBC Royal Bank corporate commercial, and the narration presents the bank as a partner that can help customers expand, grow, and pursue greater opportunities. The visible application form and branded building place those claims in ordinary banking and corporate contexts. The language is aspirational, but the supplied material shows no investment-return promise, required payment, credential request, or other supported scam mechanism. On this record, the presentation is an advertisement for banking services, not evidence of a fraudulent offer.

citations.quote: RBC Royal Bank has the global and regional strength. To help you expand and grow.
You have a partner with you on your journey. To greater opportunities.
